plan: [ In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, the dominant strategy is to bid your true value: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. Overbidding can cause negative profit if the second-highest bid exceeds your value; underbidding risks losing profitable wins when the second-highest bid lies between your bid and your value. With no exploitable history (1 round, uniform values 0–49), the optimal plan is to bid exactly my value, $4. This ensures I only win when the price (second-highest bid) is below my value, yielding nonnegative profit. ]
